about_the_game:
You think you’re the hero. The game disagrees.

A familiar JRPG feeling, with some very unfriendly surprises.
Every action shapes your fate, your relationships, and who you become.

The system watches.
The characters remember.
And the game never forgives.

Features

-             Classic turn-based battles with flashy skills and real punishment for recklessness.

-             No grindy random encounters (well… maybe just a few).

-             Smart, sarcastic dialogues that break the fourth wall (and your confidence).

-             A moral system that reacts to you, not your stats. Steal, cheat, the game remembers.

-             Enemies that evolve and mock your tactics in ways you’ll both hate and love.

-             Achievements that are more like inside jokes from the dev, and some that just exist to troll you.

You can play it smart.
You can play it kind.
Or you can play like you own the world — until it reminds you whose world this really is.

Go ahead, hero.
Try to beat a game that knows you’re playing it.

100% achievement hunters beware: finishing this game is harder than dating.

 

Will you fight to fix this broken world, or become part of the problem?

The base game is a full experience on its own. DLC expands the world further if you want to dive deeper.

This game was lovingly inspired by Epic Battle Fantasy.

Hopefully, these are old memories retold from our perspective.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: An indie RPG full of humor, secrets, and consequences—because sometimes, opening the wrong box is the worst decision you’ll ever make.
